$description: Diagram (platform/charts/Diagram.jsx, diagram.css; library wave 9, lane A): its component tokens. Neutral roles only: no color carries meaning in a diagram, the shapes and the labels do.

diagram-shape-background.$description: Diagram: the inside of a shape.

diagram-shape-border-width.$description: Diagram: the width of a shape's outline (and a group's).

diagram-shape-radius.$description: Diagram: the corners of a step's box.

diagram-terminal-radius.$description: Diagram: the round ends of a start or end shape (a pill).

diagram-label-font-family.$description: Diagram: labels are words: the UI font.

diagram-label-font-weight.$description: Diagram: a shape label's weight (and a group's name).

diagram-label-line-height.$description: Diagram: a label's line height when it wraps.

diagram-label-padding-inline.$description: Diagram: the room at a label's sides inside its shape.

diagram-decision-padding-inline.$description: Diagram: the room at a decision's sides, so the label stays inside the diamond.

diagram-detail-text.$description: Diagram: a box's second line (boxes and arrows).

diagram-connector-color.$description: Diagram: a connector and its arrowhead.

diagram-connector-label-text.$description: Diagram: a branch's label on its connector.

diagram-connector-label-font-size.$description: Diagram: a branch label's size (and a group's name).

diagram-connector-label-halo-color.$description: Diagram: the halo under a branch label, so it reads over its connector.

diagram-connector-label-halo-width.$description: Diagram: the width of the branch labels' halo.

diagram-group-background.$description: Diagram: a group container behind its shapes.

diagram-group-label-text.$description: Diagram: a group's name at its top.

diagram-active-border-color.$description: Diagram: the outline of the shape in focus and its connectors.

diagram-active-border-width.$description: Diagram: the width of the active outline.
